Name: MISSILE_PARAM_ST
Description: Missile definitions: particle effect, lifetime, hit sphere, speed, gravity, acceleration and damage. Likely a legacy param.

Fields.Name: Duration
Fields.Description: How long the missile exists in flight. In frames.

Fields.Name: Hit Sphere Radius
Fields.Description: The radius of the hit sphere. In centimetres.

Fields.Name: Initial Velocity
Fields.Description: Initial speed of the missile. In metres per second.

Fields.Name: Range
Fields.Description: Range of the missile. Past this flight distance the out-of-range gravity and acceleration apply.

Fields.Name: Gravity: In Range
Fields.Description: Gravity applied downward within range. In metres per second ^ 2.

Fields.Name: Gravity: Out of Range
Fields.Description: Gravity applied downward outside of range. In metres per second ^ 2.

Fields.Name: MP Consumption
Fields.Description: MP consumed when this missile is fired.

Fields.Name: Acceleration: In Range
Fields.Description: Acceleration whilst projectile is within distance threshold. In metres per second ^ 2.

Fields.Name: Acceleration: Out of Range
Fields.Description: Acceleration whilst projectile is beyond the distance threshold. In metres per second ^ 2.

Fields.Name: Impact ID
Fields.Description: ID spawned when the missile impacts. Target param uncertain.

Fields.Name: Expires With Lifetime
Fields.Description: If ON, the missile dies when its lifetime runs out.

Fields.Name: Impact on Expiry
Fields.Description: If ON, the missile impacts when its lifetime runs out.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID on Hit
Fields.Description: The behavior ID to apply to the victim when this missile hits.
